class.name: BoxVoxelGenerator
class.brief_description: A generator filling an axis-aligned box and the rest of space with different materials.
class.description: BoxVoxelGenerator generates one material filling an axis-aligned box and another filling the rest of space. With the default materials, it can be used with a [LayeredVoxelGenerator] to cut off generation outside the box.

members.member: The center of the box, in voxel coordinates.
The material filling the box, or [code]255[/code] to leave it undefined.
The material filling the space outside the box, [code]254[/code] for air by default, or [code]255[/code] to leave it undefined.
The size of the box, in voxels, centered on [member center].
